## Summary

The **live marketing site in this repo** is a simpler single-page layout in `pages/index.js` (hero, steps, pricing **cards**, FAQ). Features like **comparison table, Autopilot demo, device carousel, hero count-up, SVG checkmarks, and “skláče”** are **not implemented** here. CTAs **“Chci 12T transformaci”** / **“Mám zájem o VIP”** live in **`ProgramVariantsSection.js`** (app upsell, not on `bodyandmindon.cz` homepage). There is a **499 vs 599 Kč inconsistency** between marketing index / `ProgramVariantsSection` (499) and `lib/pricing.ts` / paywall (599). No **`.sr-only`** and no **waitlist backend** — only UI copy and mailto links.

If you expected the richer layout from `tmp/screenshots/plan-web-*.png`, that design does not appear to be checked into this codebase yet.
